column1: # Catalan (ca) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_one_other` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | other.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Catalan computing vocabulary (standard Catalan, commands in the second-person imperative, informal
# "tu" or impersonal wording in notices). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or
# product UI (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript ...) are not translated;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
